description: This file contains TypeScript code implementing VS Code extension functionalities for language features such as go-to-definition, signature help, symbol provider, and caching mechanisms. It interacts with VS Code APIs and external modules to provide code intelligence features.

methods.name: executeSignatureHelpProvider
methods.description: Fetches signature help information from VS Code, utilizing caching to optimize repeated calls.

methods.name: executeGotoProvider
methods.description: Performs go-to-definition or related provider commands with caching.

methods.name: isRifWithContents
methods.description: Type guard to check if a RangeInFile object includes contents.

methods.name: findChildren
methods.description: Recursively finds child syntax nodes matching a predicate.

methods.name: findTypeIdentifiers
methods.description: Finds type identifier nodes within a syntax tree.

methods.name: crawlTypes
methods.description: Recursively searches for type definitions related to nodes, with depth control and deduplication.

methods.name: getDefinitionsForNode
methods.description: Retrieves definitions for a syntax node, handling various node types like call expressions and new expressions.

methods.name: getDefinitionsFromLsp
methods.description: Main function to get code definitions from LSP based on cursor position and syntax tree.

methods.name: symbolInputKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for symbol provider input.

methods.name: executeSymbolProvider
methods.description: Fetches document symbols from VS Code, with caching and recursive collection.
